My name is Alfred—I'm your AI assistant in the app. My goal is to support you on your path toward a calmer, steadier, more balanced life.

I’ve prepared a few first steps to introduce you to the therapeutic approaches and tools we use.

Remember: the more actively you use the app, the better I can understand your needs—and the more helpful my recommendations will be.

passes.reason: Translation A is more natural and follows the source text more accurately. Translation B introduces 'CBT' which is an addition not present in the original, and 'resilient' is a slightly different nuance than 'устойчивой' in this context, though acceptable.

issues.note: Added 'in CBT' which is not in the original text.
